estimates.anchor_source: No market. Street-implied FY27 S&M share ~20.5%: LSEG FY27 adj EBITDA $5,766M (36.45%, n 44, 11 Sep 2026; data/processed/margin_build/23_final_model/23_vs_consensus.csv) less the line build's other four cost lines ($6,808M; data/processed/margin_build/40_line_build/40_annual.csv); P ~0.10 on the Street's own sd, raised to 0.30 because the Street's S&M is a residual, not a modelled line.

model.structure: FY27 revenue 0.75 x N(15,829,450) + 0.25 x N(15,100,500); FY26 S&M ex-SBC N(3,040,60); FY27 S&M growth N(14.5%,5.5) + 0.30 x (revenue growth - 10.94); ratio = S&M27 / revenue27; conditionals by F03 bucket shift the growth centre (-4.5/-2.0/0/+3.5/+0.5) and the short-tail weight (0.10/0.15/0.25/0.35/0.30)
